Who We Are We’re here to prove that the next generation of world-changing companies doesn’t have to come from a coast. It begins right here in Cowtown. TechFW is a nonprofit startup incubator and accelerator based in Fort Worth, Texas, helping entrepreneurs turn innovation into reality since 1998. We support founders at every stage through expert-led programs, strategic mentorship, and access to a powerful community. We work with scalable startups in biotech, hardware, AI, clean energy, software, and emerging technologies without taking equity. All Posts News Members Partnerships Investments Search Seven female-founded companies were selected for joint TechFW/Texas Woman’s program Briana Wucinski Aug 22, 2022 4 min read Seven woman-owned, startup businesses have been selected and funded to participate in one of two TechFW programs, courtesy of the Texas Woman’s University - Center for Women Entrepreneurs Education Awards . The Center designated $1,000 and $2,000 awards for female entrepreneurs to participate in TechFW’s ThinkLab startup accelerator or SmartStart business incubator programs. The winners were chosen based on the following criteria: 1) The founder is a female entrepreneur who is a major shareholder and decision-maker2) The founder and business are in the state of Texas3) The business is a for-profit company4) The founder must own, have licensed, or be working on proprietary technology, a trade secret, or an innovative way of doing business.
